commands.review_summary:
The branch changes exec script preflight to read and scan Python/Node script operands that resolve outside the workdir and updates the adjacent test to reject `$DM_JSON` in `node ../outside.js`.

PR surface: Source +32, Tests +10. Total +42 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: current main continues when `resolvePreflightRelativePath` returns null, and the adjacent test expects the outside-workdir `$DM_JSON` script to pass. I did not run tests in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] This remains human-gated because external contributor proof is insufficient and maintainers need to accept the compatibility/security tradeoff; the docs repair alone is too small to make automation merge-safe.

target.title: fix(exec): validate script files outside the workspace root for shell bleed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a validation security vulnerability where exec script preflight checks (designed to catch potential shell variable injections/bleed such as `$DM_JSON` in user script files) completely skipped checking any scripts that resided outside the workspace root (e.g. absolute paths or parent-directory relative paths like `../script.js`). This was because the checks relied on `relativePath` resolving to a string, and when `relativePath` was `null` (since the path was outside the workspace), the check loop silently skipped validation, potentially allowing malicious shell bleed scripts to run unchecked.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added the helper `readPreflightScriptOutsideWorkspace` to securely read file contents outside the workspace root using safe non-blocking file handles and file size limits.

Updated `validateScriptFileForShellBleed` in `src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts` to call this helper when `relativePath` is `null` (rather than skipping the file), ensuring that all script files referenced by commands are validated for shell bleed regardless of whether they lie inside or outside the workspace.

## User Impact

Strengthens sandbox security and variable injection prevention by ensuring all script files executed by the agent are validated, preventing bypasses via outside/parent paths.

## Evidence

Passed all 61 tests on branch `fix/4.1-script-preflight-outside-workspace-validation` in `src/agents/bash-tools.exec.script-preflight.test.ts`:
```
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/bash-tools.exec.script-preflight.test.ts (61 tests | 4 skipped) 262ms
```

### Real Behavior Proof

Verified by referencing a script outside the workspace containing a shell bleed variable like `const value = $DM_JSON;`. The preflight runner correctly validates it and blocks execution:
```
exec preflight: detected likely shell variable injection ($DM_JSON)
```
